messages:
marie: Quick sync — need help running a small profiling sweep for TTFT sampling changes + panel layout update for the dashboard. Looking for p95, median, tok/s across shard sizes (1/2/4 GPUs). Anyone free today?

alex: I can run a smoke bench at 15:00 PT. What's the canonical workload?

marie: thanks. Use model: rwinf-7b-ggml-q4 for private stacks, and rwinf-7b-fp16-hosted for host comparison. Prompt set: https://internal/redwood/bench/promptsets/ttft/2026-03-sampling (read-only). Command I usually use:
```
bench run --model rwinf-7b-ggml-q4 --seq 512 --shards 1,2,4 --concurrency 16 --samples 500 --metrics p95,median,tok/s --label ttft-sampling-sweep
```

sam: pinging @alex @rui — can we capture per-shard KV cache hit rate too? That helps explain regresses.

bench-bot: Job 4592 submitted by alex. Status: queued.

alex: started. will post results in ~45m. re: kv cache — adding --kv-stats flag.

nora: for dashboard panel, prefer showing p95 as absolute ms and relative % to baseline. Keep median and tok/s on separate axis.

rui: quick note — in last run I saw p95 jump 1.9x when seq=1024 due to attention kernel fallback. I'll try a microprofile and post flamegraph.

marie: thanks. if someone sees >1.3x p95 on a shard config, mark as regression and cc eng-runtime SLO thread.

alex: results pasted:
- 1 shard, seq512: median 18ms, p95 42ms, tok/s 1050, kv-hit 0.92
- 2 shards, seq512: median 22ms, p95 48ms, tok/s 1900, kv-hit 0.87
- 4 shards, seq512: median 20ms, p95 46ms, tok/s 3500, kv-hit 0.85
(see raw CSV: https://internal/redwood/bench/4592.csv)

sam: looks reasonable. small p95 bump but tok/s scales. can we add a panel with "effective latency per token" = p95 / tok/s ?

nora: yeah, that helps for cost tradeoffs.

rui: attached microprofile gist: https://gist.github.com/rui/abc123 — looks like matmul kernel recompile thrash at higher sequence lengths.

marie: action items: alex will run seq1024 / 2048 runs tomorrow with kv warmup; rui will open an issue with kernel fallback trace; nora will prototype panel showing p95 ms + % delta to baseline and effective latency per token. cc @eng-sre for alert thresholds.

alex: noted. will schedule run at 10am PT.

bench-bot: Job 4592 completed: success. artifacts: https://internal/redwood/bench/4592.tar.gz

sam: thanks all. small follow-up: can we standardize naming for bench labels? propose: component:metric-context-date (e.g., runtime:p95-ttft-20260317)

marie: agree. add to docs under eng-runtime/bench-guides.

end.
